names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 22 iunie, «Sfântul Mucenic Galaction».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 22 Ιουνίου, «Άγιος Γαλατίων», with the rank word left off. The life page behind it prints «Γαλατίων (ή Γαλακτίων)», giving both forms.

feast.note: The same menologion number this folder's greek row carries. The one life page days.pravoslavie.ru gives the company, life1377, is titled «Святые мученики Галактион, Иулиания и Сатурнин» and heads «День памяти: 22 июня»; its whole text is one sentence — Galaction was drowned in the sea for confessing Christ, and Juliana was burned together with her son Saturninus — which is what this folder already carries, so no paragraph was added. NO ru NAME FORM WAS WRITTEN: the calendar's name link gives a bare forename, and that string already has a holder among the corpus's folders, so storing it would widen a fold for the sake of a word the day line gives in the genitive anyway. The day page's own line names two of the three; the son is named only in the life page's title and text and gets no row here.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 22 июня ст. ст. — «Мчч. Галактиона и Иулиании .»
Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 22 iunie — «Sfântul Mucenic Galaction»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 22ης Ιουνίου — «Άγιος Γαλατίων»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 22 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries, and gives no year. It spells the name «Γαλατίων (ή Γαλακτίων)», the second form being the one the corpus's Romanian line «Galaction» answers to, and he is none of the corpus's four other men of the name — the disciple of Martinian, the one of Emesa, the one of Vologda and the twentieth-century Romanian. The page adds the one thing the Romanian source lacked, that he was drowned; the same day's Πομπιανός is drowned in the same words and is a separate entry. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence, and the page prints no hymn under his line.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).
